_doc: Regression gate for the analytics-agentic-speed planner + analyst prompts (one label = the pair). HARD rules block; SOFT rules warn. 'min' is a floor, 'max' a ceiling. Bounds are policy choices relative to a historical baseline, not a demonstrated noise tolerance. See calibration and cicd/README.md. The gate also requires every item evaluated and read back from Langfuse with an answer_correct score. A MISSING metric fails.

calibration.reason: The full-run baseline predates question-text and code changes. Repeated current-code runs and a held-out challenge set have not validated these bounds.

config._doc: The standard Experiment A wide config used by the historical baseline. scripts/prompt_gate.py runs exactly this; tests/test_prompt_gate.py keeps it equal to scripts/run_experiment.py (BREADTH['wide'], EXPERIMENT_A_ROUNDS).

baseline._doc: production v1 (planner v1, analyst v1), claude-opus-5-5, 15 questions, 300 scenarios/round, 2 rounds: Langfuse run breadth-300-20261126T232112Z.
